# V1.1 — Post-ship improvements

Small queue of post-V1-ship items, plus a reinstall correctness fix and the app rename that landed in this window.

| Commit | What |
|---|---|
| `1969c44` | **Reinstall fix** — `ensureLocalRow` now fetches the server row before creating a dirty stub, so reinstalling as a paired user never clobbers `couple_id`/`accentColor` with nulls. 4 new tests (303 total). |

| `98101ec` | **Rebrand to "Love, Ipon"** (bulk pass) — app renamed from the working title "PattyWallet". A follow-up cleanup pass for stragglers landed later as V1.3 item 1 (`4959ce0`). |

Verify each slice with the emulator-verification recipe (see memory: `emulator-verification-recipe`).
